Company:

 Job Area: 
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering 
 General Summary: 
 This position is not eligible for Qualcomm immigration sponsorship 
 
 Minimum Qualifications: 
• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field. 
 
 This position is not eligible for Qualcomm immigration sponsorship 


 Job Overview: 
 Qualcomm's Data Center team develops cutting-edge rack-scale AI inference solutions for next-generation liquid-cooled data centers. As part of our rapid expansion, we are seeking an experienced and highly skilled engineer to drive system-level bring-up, debug, validation, and failure analysis of accelerator cards, servers, and rack-scale platforms. This role will focus on identifying, triaging, and resolving hardware and software issues while developing robust test processes and operational infrastructure to support the delivery of industry-leading AI products.
 Key Responsibilities
 Drive end-to-end debug activities, including issue triage, root cause analysis, and communication with stakeholders.
 Investigate hardware, firmware, and software failures encountered during card, server, rack, and test fixture bring-up.
 Gather, analyze, and correlate failure data to identify trends, isolate root causes, and drive corrective actions.
 Develop, integrate, and document hardware and software bring-up, validation, and debug processes.
 Design and enhance test automation infrastructure to improve debug efficiency, validation coverage, and test stability.
 Execute validation plans and debug methodologies for accelerator cards, server platforms, Ethernet, PCIe, and high-speed I/O interfaces.
 Create debug tools, test scripts, and diagnostic procedures to accelerate issue reproduction and resolution.
 Prioritize and track issue resolution and communicate progress through regular updates on root causes, corrective actions, and overall status.
 
 Minimum Qualifications: 
 •    Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2+ years of Systems Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 1+ year of Systems Engineering or related work experience.
OR
PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.

 Required Skills and Experience
 Proven experience debugging and validating enterprise-class hardware, firmware, and software systems.
 Strong understanding of server architectures, AI accelerators or GPU cards, PCIe, networking, and system integration.
 Hands-on experience with failure analysis methodologies and root cause investigation.
 Proficiency using hardware debug equipment, including oscilloscopes, JTAG tools, and other diagnostic instrumentation.
 Familiarity with Linux-based automation environments and scripting.
 Hands-on experience working in laboratory environments and performing system bring-up activities.
 Excellent troubleshooting, problem-solving, and hardware debug skills in a Linux environment.
 Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across multiple engineering disciplines.
  
 Preferred Skills and Experience
 Experience with server manufacturing test, failure analysis, or system qualification.
 Experience developing debug and test automation tools using Python or similar scripting languages.
 Strong analytical skills with experience processing and interpreting large sets of hardware validation or manufacturing test data.
 Experience debugging PCIe, Ethernet, memory, power, or signal integrity issues using protocol or logic analyzers.
 Experience supporting rack-scale AI, HPC, or data center platforms.
 Experience supporting DevOps and IT infrastructure activities in engineering lab and test environments.
